title: Alpine House H-01
audience: design-conscious couples planning a quiet three-to-five-night mountain stay
small international groups looking for a private seasonal retreat
pageJob: Make a fictional twelve-room alpine house tangible and guide qualified guests toward checking seasonal availability without inventing photography, awards, or reviews.

facts.statement: HOUSE 01 is a benchmark-authored twelve-room house fixture in a car-free Austrian mountain village.
The house operates from December through April and from June through October.
The minimum stay is three nights in summer and four nights in winter.
Breakfast and a four-course evening menu are included; lunch is not served.
Guests arrive by village shuttle from a fictional rail station 18 minutes away.
The house has one timber sauna and a cold outdoor plunge, not a full spa.

requiredContent: clear statement that the location and brand are fictional
constraints: Do not invent guest reviews, press logos, awards, or sustainability certifications.
No photography, video, logo, map, or third-party font is supplied.
An editorial opening may be quiet, but the availability path must remain discoverable.
Reduced motion must provide a complete static reading order.

assetPolicy.instruction: Use typography, spatial composition, benchmark-authored CSS, and fact-derived diagrams; do not fabricate the place through borrowed media.

shippingBudgets.accessibilityTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA practical floor; conformance requires complete evidence
